names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 7 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Ματρωνιανός και Αντώνιος», with the rank word left off.

death.note: Stated as a reign and never recorded. This folder’s own life: «when the persecution began under Diocletian the eparch Agricolas arrested Hieron», and his two brothers, Matronianus and Antonius, went after him. The interval is Diocletian’s reign, 284–305, which is how sixty-five other folders in this corpus hold that marker. No year, because the page gives none.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. He is a separate entry from the thirty-three of Melitene, whose enumerated list of names does not include him, although the thirty-three's page says the two brothers were arrested with Hieron. The page gives him no year, so no `dates` object is proposed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
